Subject: Request: consolidated invoice schedule + staged enablement discounts for compliance addons

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the audit-log retention UI and the KMS/HSM options. Before we loop legal, procurement and engineering for an internal sign-off I need a consolidated view of pricing and an ask on two points so we can model the TCO: 

1) Can you provide a single invoice schedule that shows implementation/onboarding fees, monthly recurring for audit-log retention tiers, and HSM seat charges separately so we can allocate costs to BU P&Ls?

2) We're evaluating a staged rollout (pilot -> phase 1 -> scale). Are there structured discounts or credits you can offer if we commit to enablement milestones instead of a pure annual commit? Example: pilot (3 months) then 12/24 month full rollout.

We've attached our audit-log requirements doc (healthsprint_auditlog_requirements_v1.docx). Also please confirm:
- What format will the exported audit logs be delivered in? (JSON lines, Parquet?)
- Timeline for SOC2 evidence pointers / where we can pull sample audit artifacts during onboarding.

Would appreciate a short summary by EOD Wednesday PST so I can present to finance on Thursday.

Best,
Elena Garcia
Sr. Procurement Manager
HealthSprint

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the attachment. Quick answers up front, then a proposal below: 

- Audit log exports: JSON Lines or Parquet — we can deliver either. For streaming integrations we recommend JSONL; for bulk archival Parquet is more storage/scan efficient.
- SOC2 / evidence: we can provide pointer documents and an audit artifact package during onboarding (sample auditlog extracts, SOC2 attestation summary, and our ingestion proof-of-delivery).

Proposal (high level — will put formal quote in HubSpot after you confirm preferred options):

Option A — Minimal pilot (3 months)
- One-time onboarding fee: $12,500 (includes evidence package + SSO/KMS onboarding support)
- Audit-log retention: Tier 1 (90 days) at $0.02/GB/mo (per ingested compressed GB)
- KMS (software): $0/month during pilot; HSM seats not enabled for pilot
- Add-on: Weekly evidence bundle delivery for compliance review (no extra fee)

Option B — Phased rollout (pilot + 12 mo)
- One-time onboarding fee: $9,000 (amortized discount if you commit to 12 months within 30d of pilot end)
- Audit-log retention: Tier 2 (365 days) at $0.015/GB/mo
- KMS/HSM: HSM seat list $1,500/seat/mo; we can offer a capped model: first 3 seats at 50% list for first 6 months if you sign by 2026-11-20
- Staged enablement credit: $8,000 credit applied against onboarding if full rollout triggers within 90 days of pilot completion

Option C — Enterprise split-billing (recommended for multi-BU)
- Central invoice for Redwood services but we include a line-level meta code to let HealthSprint split charges by BU in your billing system (no extra fee)
- Implement per-BU quotas + mapping during onboarding to support chargebacks
- Volume discount: additional 5% off audit-log unit price once monthly volume > 50 TB compressed

Ben (cc'd) and I discussed a concession path that reduces up-front friction but preserves unit economics on page. If you prefer I can show a pro-forma invoice with the three options and an example split by BU (Finance-friendly) — I will attach an itemized pricing sheet (redwood-addon-pricing-options.xlsx) once you confirm which option(s) to model.

Short ask: confirm which Option(s) to model and whether HealthSprint prefers JSONL or Parquet for exports. I'll aim to get the pro-forma to you by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-addon-pricing-options.xlsx (to be attached in follow-up)

Elena — looping in a quick commercial suggestion from Redwood that might speed approval without increasing long-term discounting:

- If HealthSprint signs a 24-month commit covering audit-log storage and a minimum HSM seat pool (example: 5 seats commit), we can: 
  * Waive onboarding fee entirely OR convert it to a 12-month credit applied monthly, your choice.
  * Offer a tiered cap on HSM billings: a fixed capped-rate per-seat for months 0–6 (gives predictability) then revert to usage/seat pricing with a maximum monthly uplift of 10% month-over-month after scale kicks in.
  * Provide one-time migration assistance credit of $10k if the deal is signed by 2026-11-20.

This preserves baseline economics but gives HealthSprint a predictable ramp while they validate. Naomi — if Elena confirms interest, we'll craft the 24mo financials and a sample BU split invoice.

-Ben

Head of Sales, Enterprise

Thanks Naomi/Ben — quick clarifying items from security: 

- Export format: JSONL preferred for streaming ingest into our SIEM; Parquet for archives is fine provided you keep schema versioning notes.
- Evidence: we need a guaranteed timeline for sample evidence (SOC2 attestation + representative auditlog extracts) during onboarding. Can you commit to delivery within 10 business days of contract signature?
- Data residency: we will require EU residency for a subset of customer data later in the roadmap. Please confirm whether an EU-only residency SKU is available and whether it carries a surcharge.

Procurement: we need a formal quote + PO-ready pricing table to attach to the SOW for finance. Also please confirm if Redwood can split invoices by BU (or provide per-line billing codes) as Naomi suggested.

-Ravi

Director, Security Engineering

- Billing split: We'll provide a central invoice with line-level billing codes and a CSV mapping file so your finance team can ingest and allocate by BU automatically. This is standard for enterprise customers and there's no extra fee.

Attached: redwood-addon-pricing-options.xlsx (itemized pro-forma with Option A/B/C and a sample 3-BU split). Also attaching a draft SOW and evidence delivery checklist.

1) Please confirm preferred option(s) to model and whether you want the 24-month cap concession Ben outlined.

3) I will also add explicit language in the SOW around evidence delivery timelines and the EU add-on opt-in.

Meeting? If useful I can run a 30-min pricing & billing walkthrough tomorrow morning PST — let me know a time.
